# Lemon Cash Mini App SDK

## Docs

- [Deeplinks](https://lemoncash.mintlify.app/concepts/deeplinks.md): Direct your users to your Mini Apps using deeplinks
- [WebView Communication](https://lemoncash.mintlify.app/concepts/webview-communication.md): Understand how your mini app communicates with the Lemon Cash mobile app
- [Feature Requests & Roadmap](https://lemoncash.mintlify.app/feature-request-roadmap/feature-request-roadmap.md): Request features and track what's coming next for Lemon Mini Apps
- [Authenticate](https://lemoncash.mintlify.app/functions/authenticate.md): Authenticate a user using Sign In With Ethereum (SIWE).
- [Call Smart Contract](https://lemoncash.mintlify.app/functions/call-smart-contract.md): Interact with smart contracts on the blockchain.
- [Deposit](https://lemoncash.mintlify.app/functions/deposit.md): Initiate crypto deposits from Lemon Cash wallet to Mini App wallet.
- [isLemonWebView](https://lemoncash.mintlify.app/functions/is-webview.md): Detect if your application is running inside the Lemon WebView environment.
- [Transfer Money](https://lemoncash.mintlify.app/functions/transfer-money.md): Initiate fiat money transfers to bank accounts.
- [Withdraw](https://lemoncash.mintlify.app/functions/withdraw.md): Withdraw funds from your Mini App Wallet to Lemon Wallet.
- [Build with AI](https://lemoncash.mintlify.app/quickstart/build-with-ai.md): Use AI assistants to help you build Mini Apps faster
- [Quickstart](https://lemoncash.mintlify.app/quickstart/quickstart.md): Build your first Mini App integrated with Lemon Cash
- [Change the environment](https://lemoncash.mintlify.app/testing/changing-dev-environment.md): Test your Mini App in different environments.
- [Faucets](https://lemoncash.mintlify.app/testing/faucets.md): Get testnet tokens to test your Mini App
- [Types](https://lemoncash.mintlify.app/types/types.md): Type definitions for the Mini App SDK
